spells.notes: 전두환-era holdover in office on 1988-02-25. Named in the 1987-07-13 개각 (announced that afternoon) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1987-07-14 (매일경제), the date on the MSIT list. The 5공 cabinet handed in its resignations on 1988-02-24 (한국경제) and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25, after his term began at 0시, before the new cabinet received its 임명장 the same day (조선일보, 매일경제, 중앙일보). The end is therefore 1988-02-25, a same-day handover, and not the MSIT page's 1988-02-24. The joint 이취임식 at 과기처 was on 1988-02-26. Born in 평양, aged 53 in July 1987 (중앙일보 1987-07-14, 01100901.19870714194838001, snapshot roster/sources/science/ext88/news/articles/bk_01100901.19870714194838001.json, quote '◇박과기처▲평양출신 (53세)'), no exact birth date found. No ko.wikipedia article exists (page '박긍식' not found, 2026-09-26). Not an NA member in terms 12-22 (na_members_12_22.csv). [verifier] Start and end re-verified with sources the builder did not use (한국경제 1987-07-15, 경향신문 1987-07-14 for the 임명장 of 14 July, 동아일보 1988-02-24 and 02-25, 서울신문 and 한국경제 1988-02-26 for the 1988 handover). The 1996 ordinal list makes him the 9th 과기처 minister, directly before 李寬 (10th).

issues.desc: Start dates when the announcement and the 임명장 fell on different days. No gazette file exists before 2001. Every start in this lineage is the 임명장 day. The pairs are 박긍식 (announced 1987-07-13, 임명장 07-14), 정근모 (announced 1990-03-17, 임명장 03-19), 김진현 (named 1990-11-09, 임명장 11-10), 정근모 again (announced 1994-12-23, 임명장 12-24), 구본영 (announced 1996-08-08, 임명장 08-09) and 권숙일 (announced 1997-03-05, 임명장 03-06). The MSIT list agrees except for 구본영, where it prints the announcement day 1996. 8. 8. [verifier] The builder had kept 구본영 at 1996-08-08 to match the MSIT list and the ict lineage's 강봉균. The verifier moved 구본영's start and 정근모's second end to 1996-08-09 under the 임명장 rule, which finance.ext88 (한승수) and oceans.ext88 (신상우) already apply to the same ceremony. The ict lineage (강봉균 1996-08-08, main roster) still differs, see verification.flags.

Ends of ministers replaced in a reshuffle follow the successor's appointment (end_confidence inferred_from_successor, same-day handover), as in science.verified.json. For 이상희, the 3·17 개각 was announced on 1990-03-17 after the cabinet resigned en bloc on 03-16, some outgoing ministers held their 이임식 on 03-17, and the new ministers received their 임명장 on 03-19. The end is 1990-03-19, alternatives 03-17 and the MSIT page's 03-18. For 김용진 the reshuffle was announced on 1997-03-05 and the successor's 임명장 was given on 03-06, so his end is 1997-03-06.

김진현 end (1993 transition). 중앙일보 1993-02-25 (BigKinds 01100901.19930225151908002) says the outgoing cabinet's resignations were handed in and all accepted on 1993-02-25, which would make 02-25 his last day. 매일경제 1993-02-24 reports the 총무처 view that ministers need not resign and hand over when successors are appointed, and several outgoing ministers held their 이임식 on 1993-02-26. The end is kept at 1993-02-26 (inferred_from_successor). No 과기처-specific report of his departure was found.

박긍식 (전두환 holdover) is in scope for one day. The 5공 cabinet resigned on 1988-02-24 and 노태우 accepted the resignations on the morning of 1988-02-25, after his term began at 0시, before giving the new cabinet its 임명장 that day. The MSIT list prints 1988-02-24, the day before the successor's start. His spell starts 1987-07-14, before the window.
